name: phone-health-cleanup
description: Check iPhone or Android health and free space through a reviewed, approved cleanup plan.

interface.longDescription: Use ordinary language to review iPhone or Android storage, available battery and security facts, then approve exact cleanup actions. Includes local scripts; actual phone access needs a supported local host, separately authorized connection and dependencies. Web/cloud sessions can guide but cannot directly reach a USB phone.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check my phone’s health and help me free up space. Start read-only and show me the proposed cleanup before changing anything.
